project.name: CallMissed Voice Agent Platform
project.goal: Build and deploy a web application where users can chat, generate images, and interact with a voice agent using the CallMissed API.

architecture.overview: React frontend hosted on Firebase communicates with a FastAPI backend. FastAPI securely communicates with CallMissed using the provided API key.
flow: React frontend handles Chat, Image Generation, and Voice Agent UI
Frontend sends requests to FastAPI backend
FastAPI keeps the CallMissed API key private
FastAPI calls the appropriate CallMissed API
FastAPI returns the result to the frontend
Frontend displays the result to the user

components.name: AI Platform
components.authentication: Single API key supplied by the company
capabilities: Speech-related functionality where supported by the API

components.name: Database
responsibilities: Store users if authentication is implemented

implementation_plan.title: Study CallMissed Documentation
tasks: Identify chat endpoint and request format
Identify image generation endpoint and request format
Check required headers, models, limits, and response formats

implementation_plan.title: Create FastAPI Backend
tasks: Add request and response schemas with Pydantic

implementation_plan.title: Implement Chat
tasks: Forward request to CallMissed chat API

implementation_plan.title: Implement Image Generation
tasks: Accept image prompt and supported options
Return generated image information to frontend

implementation_plan.title: Implement Voice Agent
tasks: Understand the CallMissed voice session/WebRTC flow
Create a backend endpoint for creating a voice session
Keep the main API key server-side
Return only the client-safe session information to the browser
Connect the frontend to the voice session
Add start, stop, microphone state, and error handling

implementation_plan.title: Testing
tasks: Verify API key is never exposed to frontend

implementation_plan.title: Deployment
tasks: Deploy FastAPI backend to AWS Free Tier or equivalent
Configure CORS for the Firebase frontend domain
Verify HTTPS communication between frontend and backend

implementation_plan.title: GitHub and Submission
tasks: Document environment variables without exposing secrets
Send hosted application URL and GitHub repository URL to the requested contact

security_requirements: Never put the CallMissed API key in React source code
Use environment variables on the backend
Configure CORS to allow only the deployed frontend origin where practical
Validate user input on the backend
Do not log API keys or sensitive tokens
definition_of_done: User can send a chat message and receive an AI response
User can submit an image prompt and receive the generated image/result
User can start and interact with the voice agent from the browser
Frontend is publicly accessible over HTTPS
Backend is publicly accessible over HTTPS
GitHub repository contains setup and architecture documentation
